name: Headroom — Token Compression for AI Agents
hook: Compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they hit the LLM — reported 57% token reduction on an SRE incident benchmark (55,957 → 24,340 tokens). Ships as a Python/TypeScript library, drop-in proxy, Claude Code agent wrapper, and MCP server. Reversible: originals are cached locally and retrieved on demand.

name: Cloudflare Security Audit Skill
hook: Cloudflare's open-source, MIT-licensed skill runs a six-phase security audit on your codebase: separate agents hunt for vulns, a second set tries to disprove each finding, and the result is a machine-readable report. Now at 38,640 stars with 2,979 stars gained on Oct 22 alone — the #4 item on GitHub Trending. Ported directly from Cloudflare's internal vulnerability-discovery harness.

name: Ponytail — AI Agent Minimal Code Plugin
hook: Forces AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, 20 agents total) through a decision ladder before writing a line of code: does it already exist, can stdlib do it, can a single line solve it? The project reports −53% lines, −41% time, −26% cost vs. baseline. 172,933 stars with nearly 1,949 gained Oct 22; Ponytail 5 added a live band/board UI inside Claude Code.

name: Anthropic Knowledge Work Plugins (Official)
hook: Anthropic's official open-source set of 11 role-specific plugins (sales, legal, finance, marketing, product, data, bio-research, and more) built for Claude Cowork and Claude Code. Each plugin bundles skills, slash commands, and MCP connectors — zero code, pure markdown and JSON. 31,399 stars and 303 gained on Oct 22.
install: claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins && claude plugin install sales@knowledge-work-plugins

name: Claude Code Review — Now Generally Available
hook: As of October 15, 2026 Code Review exits research preview: 3× faster (20 min → 6–10 min), sharper findings, and per-repo Quick/Standard/Deep depth tuning. Available on Claude Team and Enterprise. Simon Willison's Oct 16 commentary: 'most changes reviewed and fixed by Claude at least once before a human is asked to look.'
install: Enable in Claude Code settings → install GitHub App → select repos

name: AI Job Search — Claude Code Job Application Framework
hook: Full job-search agent running inside Claude Code: /scrape ranks postings, /apply drafts LaTeX CVs and cover letters with a second-agent review pass, /interview builds prep packs. 63,400 stars with +3,861 on Oct 21 — #1 on GitHub Trending that day. Ships Danish job-board skills plus LinkedIn and freehire.me. MIT licensed, not affiliated with Anthropic.
install: gh repo fork MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search --clone && cd ai-job-search && python3 tools/install_portal_clis.py && claude

name: OpenCodex — Run Any LLM Behind Claude Code
hook: Provider proxy that translates Codex's Responses API so Claude Code (and Codex CLI) can route to 40+ providers — Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Supports combos (failover + weighted round-robin), sub-agent model routing, and a ChatGPT account pool. 17,800 stars. Note: some providers (including Anthropic) may flag proxy routing; check your ToS.

name: Tokens on Track — macOS Quota Tracker for Claude Code
hook: macOS 14+ menu bar app that shows live token quota usage and pace for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenRouter, and Cursor. Color-coded pacing (green/orange/red) tells you if you're spending ahead of your refill window. Includes an MCP server so coding agents can self-check remaining quota before starting large tasks. MIT licensed.

name: wshobson/agents — Multi-Harness Plugin Marketplace
hook: One repository, 94 plugins and 202 agents that install across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity CLI, and Pi. Author-format is Claude Code plugins; adapters generate the other formats. 41,500 stars with a built-in plugin-eval and Monte Carlo evaluation layer.

name: Orca — Multi-Agent Fleet Manager
hook: Manages a fleet of Claude Code (and other) coding agents running on your own subscriptions across desktop, mobile, and remote — task queues, merge controls, and live status. Hit the 100,000-star milestone this week and stayed in GitHub Trending for a fourth day straight.

name: Claude Code v2.1.307 — OTel Safety Events + API Date
hook: Latest changelog batch (v2.1.305–307): adds the claude_code.safety_event OpenTelemetry event for observability pipelines, an @claude review stop command for Code Review, and moves generated API code to the 2026-10-21 API version. v2.1.305 landed sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces on Linux and tightened allowedMcpServers filtering. Total 103 bug fixes across the three releases.

name: claude-code-pr-watch — Live PR Status Pane Mod
hook: A Claude Code mod that opens a persistent side pane showing live GitHub PR status — CI checks, review state, and merge readiness — while you code. 9 stars and updated Oct 22, so very new; pairs naturally with the newly-GA Code Review feature to keep PR health visible without leaving the terminal.
